name: Proxmox Mail Gateway Detection Suite
name_zh: Proxmox Mail Gateway 偵測套組
summary: Logins, viruses, outgoing virus and spam, quarantine releases, filter, cluster and update failures and REST API changes on Proxmox Mail Gateway, which Wazuh does not decode at all.
summary_zh: Proxmox Mail Gateway 的登入、病毒、外寄病毒與垃圾信、隔離區放行、過濾／叢集／更新故障，以及 REST API 變更；Wazuh 內建完全不解碼 PMG。
notes: Wazuh ships no decoder for Proxmox Mail Gateway: its Proxmox decoders take pvedaemon, pveproxy and pvestatd by name, not pmgdaemon, pmgproxy or pmg-smtp-filter. On a PMG 9 gateway a failed web login reached only the generic rule 2501, and nothing PMG writes about mail, quarantines, the cluster or its own services matched a rule. Replaying a sample of 4,382 real lines from nine days of one gateway (PMG, ClamAV and postscreen), with no list filled in, raised one pack alert a day (a failing daily package update) and one first-login alert for its API account; the other 491 logins of that account stayed at level 2.

Logins, quiet by default with no list filled in. PMG writes a successful login, and every renewal of an open session (every 15 minutes), as the same line, with the account but without the client address. An ordinary login is recorded at level 2. The first login of each account on a gateway is level 3, once ever (first-time-seen), so an API account that logs in every 2 minutes (measured: 720 logins a day) alerts once. root@pam, PMG's built-in superuser and the only account of the pam realm, is level 3 at most once an hour per gateway; the renewals of its session in that hour are level 2. A login after three failures for the same account within 10 minutes is level 10, after a brute-force alert for it level 12. A failure is level 5 with the client address, six from one address within five minutes level 10. End users opening their spam quarantine are level 2. etc/lists/jt-pmg-service-accounts is optional tuning: listed accounts drop to level 0 on success and still alert after failures. The PAM copy of a failed login in auth.log (built-in 2501, level 5) drops to level 2 because pmgdaemon reports the same failure with the realm and the address.

Logins from a public address: since the syslog line has no address, the pmgproxy access log is used. A login request answered from an address outside 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, ::1, fc00::/7 and fe80::/10 is level 5, further requests from that address within the hour level 2. The web interface logs in through /api2/extjs/, which answers 200 even for a wrong password, so this means a login or a renewal was attempted from the internet; the account is in the syslog line of the same second. Which account it was cannot be told from this line, so the pack cannot raise a superuser login from the internet above level 5. PMG writes client addresses IPv4-mapped (::ffff:a.b.c.d), which Wazuh's address matching does not see as IPv4: the pack recognises private addresses by the start of the line, and strips the prefix in its own decoder for the failure lines.

Viruses: a virus found in a mail is level 7 (one line per mail); a ClamAV heuristic, which PMG only adds to the spam score, is level 3. PMG decides whether a mail is outgoing but logs only the name of the rule that acted, so outgoing mail is recognised by rule name: etc/lists/jt-pmg-outbound-rules lists the rules that act on outgoing mail only, with PMG's default names 'Virus Alert' and 'Block outgoing Spam'. A block or quarantine by one of them is level 12 for a virus (an infected internal sender) and level 10 for spam (a compromised account or host), at most one alert a minute. There is no generic direction signal to use instead: PMG writes the direction only on the connection line (port 10023 outgoing, 10024 inbound), tied to the mail by the process ID alone, and Wazuh's pre-decoder discards process IDs. So the shipped list holds PMG's own default names, which works on a gateway with the default rules; a gateway whose outgoing rules are renamed or translated needs their names added, and until then an outgoing virus is still the level 7 of the first sentence while outgoing spam is not raised. The clamd copy of a mail virus (built-in 52502, level 8) drops to level 2; scans outside the PMG spool still alert.

Quarantine releases: from the spam quarantine level 3 (end users release their own spam), from the attachment quarantine level 5, from the virus quarantine level 10. The syslog line does not say who released it; the pmgproxy access log line for POST .../quarantine/content just before it names the account.

Failures that stop or weaken filtering are level 10: virus scanning failed, an accepted mail that cannot be handed back to Postfix, Postfix unable to reach the filter on 127.0.0.1:10023/10024, a burst of filter process errors, and pmg-smtp-filter, Postfix, clamd, pmgpolicy or PostgreSQL failing under systemd; other PMG services failing are level 7. When clamd is down, clamdscan still prints a summary and PMG may log nothing about the scan, so the service rule is the one that catches it.

Housekeeping: cluster synchronisation errors and an aborted LDAP profile sync are level 7 (the sync runs every 2 minutes and is silent while it reports 0 errors; a broken peer alerts at most every 30 minutes). A failed ClamAV signature update or a download refused by the mirror is level 7, at most hourly; the built-in rule 52509 keeps those at level 0. A failed task is level 5, a failed ACME certificate renewal level 7. A root shell opened from the web interface or a service stopped from it is level 5.

DNS blocklists: an answer in 127.255.255.0/24 (Spamhaus refusing a query sent through a public resolver, or too many queries) is level 10, because a postscreen setup without an answer filter then scores every client as listed; repeated postscreen lookup timeouts are level 7. These rules and the Postfix TLS certificate rule apply to any Postfix server, not only PMG.

REST API changes from the pmgproxy access log: users, realms and two-factor settings level 8 (a second factor removed, disabled or unlocked 10), mail filter rules 8 (rule database reset to factory defaults 10), trusted networks and transports 8, SMTP welcomelist 7, other gateway settings 6, cluster membership 8, configuration restore 8, deleting queued mail 6, certificates 6, node reboot 6. The agent group keeps only POST, PUT and DELETE requests. The web interface calls /api2/extjs/, which logs status 200 even for a refused change, so these alerts mean the change was requested; the acting user is in the full log line.

Deliberately not alerted: rejections by postscreen, DNS blocklists, SPF or greylisting, and quarantined or marked inbound spam. They are the gateway doing its job; the built-in Postfix rules (3303, 3306 and their burst rules 3353, 3356) still apply to them, and the pack does not change those because they cover every Postfix server, not only PMG. No active response is offered against mail senders: postscreen and the blocklists reject them before SMTP, spam sources change addresses, and a wrong firewall block stops all mail from that sender.
notes_zh: Wazuh 沒有 Proxmox Mail Gateway 的解碼器：內建的 Proxmox 解碼器只認 pvedaemon、pveproxy、pvestatd，不認 pmgdaemon、pmgproxy 或 pmg-smtp-filter。在 PMG 9 閘道上，網頁登入失敗只命中通用規則 2501，PMG 關於郵件、隔離區、叢集與自身服務的記錄完全不命中任何規則。以一台閘道九天內 4,382 行真實記錄（PMG、ClamAV、postscreen）的樣本重放，不填任何清單，本套件每天只產生一則告警（每日套件更新失敗），另有該閘道 API 帳號的一則首次登入告警；這個帳號其餘 491 次登入都停在 level 2。

登入預設就安靜，不必填任何清單。PMG 把成功登入與開著的工作階段每 15 分鐘一次的續期記成同一行，只有帳號、沒有用戶端位址。一般登入記錄為 level 2。每個帳號在一台閘道上的第一次登入為 level 3，永遠只有一次（first-time-seen），所以每 2 分鐘登入一次的 API 帳號（實測每天 720 次）只告警一次。root@pam 是 PMG 內建的超級使用者，也是 pam realm 唯一的帳號，每台閘道每小時最多一則 level 3，這一小時內的工作階段續期為 level 2。同一帳號 10 分鐘內失敗三次後登入成功為 level 10，在針對它的暴力破解告警之後登入成功為 level 12。登入失敗為 level 5 並帶用戶端位址，同一位址五分鐘內失敗六次為 level 10。一般使用者開啟垃圾信隔離區為 level 2。etc/lists/jt-pmg-service-accounts 只是選用的調校：列入的帳號成功登入降為 level 0，失敗之後的登入仍會告警。auth.log 裡 PAM 那份登入失敗（內建 2501，level 5）降為 level 2，因為 pmgdaemon 已帶著 realm 與位址回報同一次失敗。

來自公共位址的登入：syslog 那行沒有位址，所以改用 pmgproxy 存取記錄。登入請求的來源不在 10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、::1、fc00::/7、fe80::/10 時為 level 5，同一位址一小時內的後續請求為 level 2。網頁介面透過 /api2/extjs/ 登入，密碼錯誤也回 200，所以這代表「有人從網際網路嘗試登入或續期」；帳號在同一秒的 syslog 那行。從這行看不出是哪個帳號，所以本套件無法把超級使用者從網際網路登入提高到 level 5 以上。PMG 把用戶端位址寫成 IPv4 對映格式（::ffff:a.b.c.d），Wazuh 的位址比對不會當成 IPv4：本套件以記錄行的開頭辨識私有位址，登入失敗那行則在自己的解碼器裡去掉前綴。

病毒：郵件中發現病毒為 level 7（每封信一行）；ClamAV 的啟發式命中在 PMG 只加進垃圾信分數，為 level 3。PMG 自己判斷郵件是不是外寄，但記錄只寫出動作的規則名稱，所以外寄郵件以規則名稱辨識：etc/lists/jt-pmg-outbound-rules 列出只處理外寄郵件的規則，內含 PMG 預設的「Virus Alert」與「Block outgoing Spam」。被其中一條阻擋或隔離時，病毒為 level 12（內部寄件者中毒），垃圾信為 level 10（帳號或主機可能遭入侵），每分鐘最多一則。沒有可替代的通用方向訊號：PMG 只在連線那行寫出方向（10023 埠為外寄、10024 為外來），與郵件之間只靠處理程序 ID 對應，而 Wazuh 的預先解碼會丟掉處理程序 ID。所以出廠清單放的是 PMG 自己的預設名稱，規則維持預設的閘道直接可用；外寄規則改過名稱或翻譯過的閘道要把名稱加進清單，在那之前外寄病毒仍是第一句的 level 7，外寄垃圾信則不會告警。clamd 那份郵件病毒記錄（內建 52502，level 8）降為 level 2；PMG 佇列以外的掃描仍會告警。
隔離區放行：從垃圾信隔離區放行為 level 3（使用者會自行放行），從附件隔離區為 level 5，從病毒隔離區為 level 10。syslog 那行沒寫是誰放行的；緊接在前、pmgproxy 存取記錄裡的 POST .../quarantine/content 那行有帳號。

會讓過濾停擺或打折的故障為 level 10：病毒掃描失敗、已接收的郵件無法交回 Postfix、Postfix 連不上 127.0.0.1:10023/10024 的過濾程式、過濾程序短時間內大量出錯，以及 pmg-smtp-filter、Postfix、clamd、pmgpolicy、PostgreSQL 在 systemd 下失敗；其他 PMG 服務失敗為 level 7。clamd 停止時 clamdscan 仍會印出摘要，PMG 可能完全不記錄掃描失敗，所以抓到它的是服務規則。

例行維護：叢集同步錯誤與 LDAP 設定檔同步中止為 level 7（同步每 2 分鐘一次，回報 0 errors 時不出聲；壞掉的節點最多每 30 分鐘告警一次）。ClamAV 病毒碼更新失敗或被鏡像站拒絕為 level 7，每小時最多一次；內建規則 52509 把這些留在 level 0。任務失敗為 level 5，ACME 憑證自動更新失敗為 level 7。從網頁介面開啟 root shell 或停止服務為 level 5。
DNS 黑名單：回應落在 127.255.255.0/24（Spamhaus 拒絕經由公共 DNS 送來的查詢或查詢過多）為 level 10，因為沒有設定回應過濾的 postscreen 會因此把每個用戶端都當成已列入；postscreen 查詢一再逾時為 level 7。這幾條與 Postfix TLS 憑證規則適用於任何 Postfix 伺服器，不只 PMG。

REST API 變更取自 pmgproxy 存取記錄：使用者、realm 與雙因素設定為 level 8（移除、停用或解鎖第二因素為 10），郵件過濾規則為 8（規則資料庫重設回出廠值為 10），信任網段與 transport 為 8，SMTP 白名單為 7，其他閘道設定為 6，叢集成員變更為 8，設定還原為 8，刪除佇列中的郵件為 6，憑證為 6，節點重新開機為 6。agent 群組只保留 POST、PUT、DELETE 請求。網頁介面呼叫的是 /api2/extjs/，即使變更被拒絕也記錄狀態 200，所以這些告警代表「有人要求變更」；執行者在完整記錄行中。

刻意不告警：postscreen、DNS 黑名單、SPF、灰名單的拒收，以及被隔離或標記的外來垃圾信。那是閘道在正常工作；內建的 Postfix 規則（3303、3306 及其大量發生規則 3353、3356）照樣適用，本套件不改它們，因為它們涵蓋所有 Postfix 伺服器，不只 PMG。不提供針對寄件者的主動回應：postscreen 與黑名單在 SMTP 之前就拒收了，垃圾信來源會換位址，而誤封的防火牆規則會擋掉該寄件者所有的郵件。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: pmg
agent_group.description: The Proxmox Mail Gateway log outside syslog: REST API changes from the pmgproxy access log

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Assign the PMG nodes to the pmg group
setup.title_zh: 把 PMG 節點加入 pmg 群組
setup.body: The group collects /var/log/pmgproxy/pmgproxy.log, the REST API access log, keeping requests that change something and answered login requests (the only record of a login's client address). Everything else (logins, mail filter, quarantine, cluster sync, Postfix, ClamAV) comes from syslog, which the agent already reads from /var/log/syslog or /var/log/mail.log in its own ossec.conf. Read each copy once: an agent that reads /var/log/syslog together with mail.log, mail.info or messages receives every mail line two or three times, and every alert with it (measured on one gateway: three copies of each Postfix and ClamAV line). On a node that logs only to journald, add a journald localfile to the agent's own configuration instead.
setup.body_zh: 群組會收集 REST API 存取記錄 /var/log/pmgproxy/pmgproxy.log，保留會改變東西的請求與已回應的登入請求（登入的用戶端位址只記在這裡）。其餘內容（登入、郵件過濾、隔離區、叢集同步、Postfix、ClamAV）來自 syslog，agent 本來就在自己的 ossec.conf 讀 /var/log/syslog 或 /var/log/mail.log。每份內容只讀一次：同時讀 /var/log/syslog 與 mail.log、mail.info 或 messages 的 agent，每行郵件記錄會收到兩三次，告警也跟著重複（一台閘道實測：每行 Postfix 與 ClamAV 記錄三份）。若節點只寫 journald，請改在該 agent 自己的設定加上 journald 的 localfile。
setup.verify: Change and save any setting under Configuration > Mail Proxy. Expect rule 132466 (level 6) on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 在「Configuration > Mail Proxy」改一個設定並儲存，manager 端應出現規則 132466（level 6）。

setup.title: Optional: silence the first-login alert of automation accounts
setup.title_zh: 選用：讓自動化帳號連第一次登入也不告警
setup.body: Not needed for quiet operation: an account that logs in every few minutes is already level 2 after its first login. List an account here only if even that one alert is unwanted, one line per account, the full user ID with its realm as PMG writes it, then reload the ruleset. A login after failures still alerts for listed accounts.
setup.body_zh: 安靜運作不需要這一步：每幾分鐘登入一次的帳號，第一次登入之後本來就是 level 2。只有連那一則告警都不想要時才列入，每個帳號一行，寫 PMG 記錄裡含 realm 的完整使用者 ID，加入後重新載入規則集。列入的帳號在失敗之後登入仍會告警。

setup.title: Name your outgoing-only PMG rules
setup.title_zh: 列出你自己的外寄專用 PMG 規則
setup.body: The list holds PMG's default names. If you renamed or translated them, or have rules of your own that act only on outgoing mail, add each name exactly as shown in Mail Filter > Rules, followed by :virus or :spam, then reload the ruleset. A name that contains a colon must be written in double quotes.
setup.body_zh: 清單內含 PMG 的預設名稱。若你改過或翻譯過這些名稱，或有自己的外寄專用規則，請照「Mail Filter > Rules」顯示的名稱逐一加入，後接 :virus 或 :spam，再重新載入規則集。名稱含冒號時要用雙引號括起來。

setup.title: Activate the outgoing spam rule in PMG
setup.title_zh: 在 PMG 啟用外寄垃圾信規則
setup.body: PMG ships 'Virus Alert' active and 'Block outgoing Spam' inactive. Without an active outgoing spam rule PMG relays outgoing spam and rule 132424 never fires. Activating it is a change on the gateway: outgoing mail that scores as spam (level 3 and up by default) is blocked and the administrator is notified, so check the score threshold against your own outgoing mail first.
setup.body_zh: PMG 出廠時「Virus Alert」為啟用、「Block outgoing Spam」為停用。沒有啟用的外寄垃圾信規則，PMG 會照常轉送外寄垃圾信，規則 132424 永遠不會觸發。啟用它是閘道端的變更：分數達垃圾信標準（預設 level 3 以上）的外寄郵件會被阻擋並通知管理者，請先用自己的外寄郵件確認門檻。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the PMG web interface
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 PMG 網頁介面失敗的位址
active_response.body: After rule 132405 (six failed logins from one address in five minutes), drops all traffic from that address on the attacked PMG node for 10 minutes, using iptables or nftables. The pack decodes the address without the ::ffff: prefix PMG writes, so the IPv4 rule applies. Risks: the block covers every port, not only 8006, so a host that also sends mail through the gateway (an internal mail server, users behind a shared NAT address submitting on port 26, a cluster peer) has its mail refused for 10 minutes; an administrator who mistypes a password is locked out; if the web interface sits behind a reverse proxy, the proxy's address is blocked and with it everyone. Put management networks, mail servers and cluster nodes in the manager's white_list first. Do not attach this to SMTP rejections.
active_response.body_zh: 規則 132405（同一位址五分鐘內登入失敗六次）觸發後，在被攻擊的 PMG 節點上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址所有流量 10 分鐘。本套件解碼時已去掉 PMG 寫的 ::ffff: 前綴，所以 IPv4 規則會生效。風險：封鎖涵蓋所有連接埠而不只 8006，因此同時透過閘道寄信的主機（內部郵件伺服器、共用 NAT 位址後經 26 埠送信的使用者、叢集另一節點）會有 10 分鐘信件被拒；一再打錯密碼的管理者會被擋在外面；若網頁介面在反向代理後面，被封的是代理的位址，所有人一起被擋。請先把管理網段、郵件伺服器與叢集節點加入 manager 的 white_list。不要把它套用在 SMTP 拒收上。
